description: Day 5 of the demo: the second call on the same deal. Ramesh says the total was 25,000 (his offer on call 1; both agreed 22,000), then both agree a change by voice: the balcony wall, 2,000 extra, 24,000 in all. Fields as in demo_call_1.json.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Main Sunita. Main bhi sehmat hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam, aadha kaam ho gaya. Total pachees hazaar tay hua tha na?

then.gawah: says both agreed 22,000 on call 1, plays that moment, and asks which they mean

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Nahi, baees hazaar hi tay hua tha.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji, baees hi. Galti ho gayi.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Ek kaam aur hai. Balcony ki deewar bhi paint kar dijiye.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ho jayega madam. Uske do hazaar extra lagenge.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, do hazaar extra. Total chaubees hazaar.

then.gawah: says the change, 22,000 to 24,000, and asks both to say haan

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji, mujhe bhi manzoor hai.

then.gawah: says the change holds: the total is now 24,000
